description: This file implements functions and classes related to capturing, symbolizing, and managing tracebacks in the PyTorch profiler, including handling Python, C++, and script frames.

classes.name: CapturedTraceback
classes.description: Class managing traceback data, including gathering, traversing, clearing, and symbolizing frames from Python, C++, and script sources.

classes.name: PyFrameHash
classes.description: Hash functor for PyFrame objects used in unordered_map.

classes.name: PyFrameEq
classes.description: Equality comparator for PyFrame objects used in unordered_map.

methods.name: CapturedTraceback::gather
methods.description: Collects traceback frames from Python, script, and C++ sources based on flags.

methods.name: CapturedTraceback::traversePython
methods.description: Traverses Python frames using a visitor pattern.

methods.name: CapturedTraceback::~CapturedTraceback
methods.description: Destructor that releases Python frames if present.

methods.name: symbolize
methods.description: Converts raw traceback addresses into symbolized frames, handling deduplication and cross-interpreter considerations.

methods.name: CapturedTraceback::addPythonUnwinder
methods.description: Registers a new Python unwinder in a thread-safe manner.
